fincadas: fincar — planted, fixed in the ground (past part. fem. pl.; fincadas son las tiendas 'the tents are pitched'; = hincadas, clavadas)
tañién: tañer — they were sounding, playing (imperfect 3rd pl., -ién ending; = tañían)
alegravas: alegrar + se — he rejoiced, was glad (imperfect 3rd sg. alegrava with the reflexive se run on; = se alegraba)
quiérel: querer + le — wants, is about to (present 3rd sg. quiere + dative le 'her'; querer + inf. 'to be about to'; quiérel crebar el coraçón 'her heart is about to break'; = se le quiere quebrar)
ffazie: fazer — it did, was so (imperfect 3rd sg., -ie ending; doubled ff a spelling only; assí ffazie a las dueñas 'so it did to the ladies', the same fear took them; = hacía)
nasquieran: nascer — they had been born (3rd pl. in -ra, old pluperfect indicative sense; del día que nasquieran 'since the day they were born'; = habían nacido)
vidieran: veer — they had seen (3rd pl. in -ra, old pluperfect indicative sense; = habían visto, vieran)
prisos: prender + se — he took hold of (strong preterite 3rd sg. priso + reflexive se; prisos a la barba 'he took himself by the beard'; = se asió, se tomó)
pondrán: poner — they will put, set (future 3rd pl.; = pondrán)
quáles: qual — what sort, which (pl., interrogative/relative; veredes quáles son 'you will see what they are like'; = cuáles)
sseer: seer — to be (infinitive, doubled s- spelling; = ser); an a sse[e]r 'they are to be' (aver a + inf.; = serán)
colgar: colgar — to hang (infinitive; colgar los han 'they will hang them', split future; = los colgarán)
vocaçión: vocaçión — vow, votive offering (from Latin vocatio 'a calling'; vocaçión es que fizo 'it is a vow that he made'; most likely sense, rare word, not certain; closest voto)
perdiendo: perder — losing (gerund; perdiendo van el pavor 'they go on losing their fear'; = perdiendo)
vigor: vigor — vigour, force; a vigor 'swiftly' (Pidal 'con presteza'; cavalgan a vigor 'they ride swiftly'; = con presteza)
adentro: adentro — inside, within (adverb; por las huertas adentro 'right into the orchards'; = adentro)
vidolo: veer + lo — he saw it/him (strong preterite 3rd sg. vido + object lo; = lo vio)
atalaya: atalaya — watchman, lookout (also the watchtower; here the sentinel; = atalaya)
tanxo: tañer — he rang, sounded (strong preterite 3rd sg., x = sh-sound; tanxo el esquila 'rang the bell'; = tañó)
esquila: esquila — small bell, alarm bell (= esquila)
prestas: presto — ready (fem. pl.; prestas son las mesnadas 'the troops are ready'; = prestas, listas)
adóbanse: adobar + se — they get ready, equip themselves (present 3rd pl. + reflexive; = se aprestan, se arman)
cometiénlos: cometer + los — they were attacking them (imperfect 3rd pl. cometién, -ién ending, + object los; = los acometían)
sácanlos: sacar + los — they drive them out, take them out (present 3rd pl. + object los; = los sacan)
fea: feo — ugly, foul (fem.; a fea guisa 'in a sorry, shameful fashion'; = fea)
dura: durar — it lasts, goes on (present 3rd sg.; = dura)
comién: comer — they ate (imperfect 3rd pl., -ién ending; los que comién so pan 'those who ate his bread'; = comían)
cuéntangelo: contar + ge + lo — they tell him it (present 3rd pl. + dative ge, = le before lo, + object lo; = se lo cuentan)
prieta: prieto — dark (fem.; por la mañana prieta, Pidal 'cerca del amanecer', in the dark before dawn; 'close, tight' also possible; = prieta, oscura)
soltura: soltura — absolution (lit. 'loosing', from soltar; Pidal 'absolución de pecados'; = absolución)
penssad: pensar — think, set your mind to (imperative 2nd pl.; penssad de cavalgar 'make ready to ride'; = pensad)
fferir: ferir — to strike, attack (infinitive, doubled f-; ir los hemos fferir 'we will go and strike them'; = herir)
passará: passar — it will pass (future 3rd sg.; non passará por al 'it will not be otherwise'; = pasará)
vezcamos: vençer — we may conquer (present subjunctive 1st pl., -zc- form; que nos los vezcamos 'that we conquer them'; = venzamos)
cojan: coger — they may gather, harvest (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; cojan el pan 'gather the grain'; = cojan, recojan)
damor: de + amor — of love, with affection (damor e de voluntad 'with love and good will, gladly'; = de amor)
queredes: querer — you wish (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = queréis)
dadme: dar + me — give me (imperative 2nd pl. dad + enclitic me; = dadme)
entrada: entrar — entered, come (past part. fem. sg.; la noch es entrada 'night has fallen'; = entrada)
adobasse: adobar + se — to get oneself ready, arm (infinitive adobar + reflexive se, the r assimilated to the s; = adobarse)
cantava: cantar — he sang, was singing (imperfect 3rd sg.; la missa les cantava 'he was singing the mass for them'; = cantaba)
sultura: sultura — absolution (variant spelling of soltura, as printed; = absolución)
muriere: morir — (whoever) shall die (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; el que muriere 'he who dies'; = muriere, now muera)
préndol: prender + le — I take from him (present 1st sg. prendo + dative le; préndol yo los pecados 'I take his sins from him', I absolve him; = le quito)
pídovos: pedir + vos — I ask you (present 1st sg. pido + object vos; = os pido)
dona: dona — gift, boon (fem., from Latin dona, plural of donum; pídovos una dona 'I ask a gift of you'; = don, dádiva)
seam: seer + me — may it be to me (present subjunctive 3rd sg. sea + dative me; seam presentada 'let it be granted me'; = séame, me sea)
presentada: presentar — presented, granted (past part. fem. sg.; = presentada)
feridas: ferida — blow, wound (fem. pl.; las feridas primeras 'the first blows'; = heridas)
otorgadas: otorgar — granted (past part. fem. pl.; = otorgadas)
desaquí: desaquí — from here on, henceforth (des + aquí; = desde aquí)
mandadas: mandar — ordered, granted (past part. fem. pl.; vos sean mandadas 'let them be granted to you'; = mandadas)

__broaden__.coraçón: coraçón — heart (= corazón) · also por coraçón 'willingly, heartily, with a will' (lo an por coraçón) · also de coraçón 'heartily, with a will' (adóbanse de coraçón 'they arm with a will')
__broaden__.guisa: guisa — manner, fashion; a guisa de 'in the fashion of' · a vuestra guisa 'as you see fit, in your own way' (prended a vuestra guisa 'take as you please') · also de guisa que 'in such a way that' (de guisa irán por ellas que … 'in such a manner will they go for them that …'; = de modo que) · also a fea guisa 'in a shameful fashion' (sácanlos de las huertas mucho a fea guisa 'they drive them out most shamefully')
__broaden__.abremos: aver — we shall have (future 1st pl., syncopated; = habremos) · also abremos a + inf. 'we shall' (aver a + inf. as a future: [abremos a ganar] = ganaremos)
__broaden__.santa: santo — Saint (fem.); Santa María, the cathedral of Burgos · santa — holy (adjective; santa Trinidad 'the Holy Trinity', santa María madre 'holy Mary, (thy) mother', the Virgin) · also Santa María — the church (cathedral) of Valencia, Don Jerome's see, where the drums are to be hung (colgar los han en Santa María madre del Criador)
__broaden__.maría: María — Mary; Santa María, the cathedral of Burgos · also Santa María — Albarracín (Teruel), held by the Aben Razín (Pidal; por Santa María vos vayades passar) · also Santa María — the church (cathedral) of Valencia, Don Jerome's see (colgar los han en Santa María)
__broaden__.se: se — himself/herself/itself (reflexive pronoun) · also se — passive 'is, are' (cómmo se gana el pan 'how bread is earned'; = se, passive-reflexive) · also se — ethic/intensive dative 'for himself, with his own eyes' (él se lo vío con los ojos 'he saw it himself')
__broaden__.mejor: mejor — better, best (adverb; quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she knows how'; = mejor) · also mejor — better (adjective; oy es día bueno e mejor será cras 'today is a good day and tomorrow will be better')
__broaden__.salido: salir — gone out, exiled (past part., used as a noun; el salido de Castiella 'the one banished from Castile'; = salido) · also salir — gone out, ended (past part. with es, intransitive perfect; el día es salido 'the day has gone'; = ha salido, ha pasado)
__broaden__.do: do — where, as (relative adverb, Latin de ubi; = donde) · also do — wherever, whenever (generalizing, with subjunctive: do yo vos enbiás 'wherever I might send you'; the exact sense is uncertain) · also dar — I give (present 1st sg.; d'aquí vos do mi graçia 'from here I give you my favor'; = doy) · also do — for don, 'lord' (title before a name; el obispo do Jero[me] 'the bishop don Jerome')
__broaden__.ir: ir — to go (infinitive; = ir) · ir + gerund in a split future (ir nos hemos pagando 'we shall go on paying ourselves'; = nos iremos pagando) · also ir + infinitive in a split future (ir los hemos fferir 'we shall go and strike them'; = los iremos a herir)
__broaden__.vale: valer — it is worth (present 3rd sg.; que más vale de mill marcos 'which is worth more than a thousand marks'; = vale) · also va + le — 'it goes on (…ing) for him' (ir + gerund with enclitic le: Yal creçe la barba e vale allongando 'and it goes on lengthening for him'; = se le va alargando) · also más vale que 'it is better that' (impersonal; más vale que nos los vezcamos 'better that we conquer them')
__broaden__.valdrá: valer — he will be worth, will count for (future 3rd sg.; = valdrá) · also valer — will help, aid (Dios nos valdrá 'God will help us'; = ayudará)
__broaden__.cara: cara — face · also de cara 'face to face, facing the enemy' (lidiando de cara 'fighting face to face')
__broaden__.fóredes: seer — (when) you shall be (future subjunctive 2nd pl. of ser, Pidal's [ó]; quando fóredes yantado 'when you have dined'; = fuereis) · also ir — you go (future subjunctive 2nd pl., same form as ser; quando vos los fóredes ferir 'when you go to strike them'; = fuereis, vayáis)
__broaden__.voluntad: voluntad — will, willingness; de voluntad e de grado, a doubled formula, 'willingly and gladly' · God's will (commo fo tu voluntad 'as was your will'); de toda voluntad 'with all one's heart' · also de buena voluntad 'gladly, willingly' (the formula of assent); a toda su voluntad 'wholly to his satisfaction, at his will' · also damor e de voluntad 'with love and good will, gladly' (the formula of assent)
__broaden__.al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least' · also a + el standing for a + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (al espada = a la espada) · also al — 'other thing, the rest' (neuter, Latin alius; de lo al non pienssan nada 'of anything else they think nothing'; distinct from a + el) · also a + el before an infinitive 'on, upon' (al exir de Salón 'on leaving the Jalón'; = al salir) · al 'the other thing, the rest' in al feredes adelant 'the rest you will do later' · also por al 'otherwise, for any other reason' (non passará por al 'it will not be otherwise'); a mí mandedes al 'order me something else', give me another charge (the likelier reading of a terse line)
__broaden__.dos: dos — two · also do + se, 'when/where … (they)' (Dos fallan con los moros 'when they come upon the Moors', Pidal 'cuando se encuentran'; = cuando se encuentran)
